note: Neither view is labelled with its avenue or block, so it is the residential street section of the district's two avenues around the scene date, not Prairie Avenue's own: a wide walk set back behind a grass parkway with a single row of closely spaced elms, a row of dressed-stone carriage blocks along the parkway's edge, a cast-iron lamp post on the parkway, and a smooth light roadway.
